entities.name: Selçuk Öztürk
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Selçuk Öztürk is a Dutch politician of Turkish descent who served as an MP from 8 November 2012 until 30 March 2021. He is a former member of the Labour Party (PvdA). On 13 November 2014, Öztürk and Tunahan Kuzu left the Labor Party and have formed the Group Kuzu/Öztürk, later renamed DENK.
